Why: PGD2 sensitises DRG neurons through DP1
Note: In DRG neurons DP1 raises the NaV1.8 and NaV1.9 currents and lowers the firing threshold; no pain test in animals. In the spinal cord DP1 acts the other way (Minami 1997, Telleria-Diaz 2008), and in cartilage DP1 protects (Ouhaddi 2017).
References: Ebersberger A et al. Effects of prostaglandin D2 on tetrodotoxin-resistant Na+ currents in DRG neurons of adult rat. Pain 2011. 2011. doi: 10.1016/j.pain.2011.01.033. PMID: 21345590.
